needs.what: the disguise alternative cast (702.168): cast face down for {3} as a 2/2 colourless nameless creature that has ward {2}, turnable face up for the printed disguise cost as a special action
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `morph` in card_level_cost_keys gives the face-down {3} 2/2 and the turn-face-up action, but its face-down characteristics carry no abilities, so a disguised permanent would lack ward {2}; the engine's only face-down ward is CLOAK_WARD, supplied by the cloak rule to cloaked permanents, and nothing on a card can select it for its own face-down cast
